hookups.source: https://dwr.virginia.gov/camping-on-wmas/ ('Camping is primitive, temporary and dispersed. There are no established campsites and no amenities (electric, potable water, dump stations, restrooms, convenience stations).'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://dwr.virginia.gov/camping-on-wmas/ ('no amenities (electric, potable water, dump stations, restrooms, convenience stations)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Camping on a Virginia WMA needs a written camping authorization ($10, up to six people) from Go Outdoors Virginia or a license agent, which sets the trip's start and end dates; 14 nights at most. Only in previously cleared spots, and 'unlawful to camp within 300 feet of any lake or facility'. DWR: 'WMA roads are not suitable for long vehicles or trailers ... Some WMAs may not allow travel trailers or RVs.' C.F. Phelps lists Primitive Camping among its activities.

booking.source: https://dwr.virginia.gov/camping-on-wmas/ + https://dwr.virginia.gov/wma/c-f-phelps/ (Recreational Opportunities: 'Primitive Camping'; Rogers Ford Boat Launch), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Vehicle access to the Rogers Ford Boat Launch closes the last Saturday in September to the first Saturday in January and the second Saturday in April to the third Saturday in May; the launch stays open on foot (about 1 mile down the gravel road).

season.source: https://dwr.virginia.gov/wma/c-f-phelps/ ('Vehicle access to the Rogers Ford Boat Launch through the gate near the sighting-in range will be closed according to the schedule below ... Last Saturday in September to First Saturday in January: CLOSED; Second Saturday in April to Third Saturday in May: CLOSED'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on DWR's C.F. Phelps page that primitive camping is still allowed on the WMA, and from DWR's statewide camping page: no hookups, no water/dump/restrooms, 14-night limit, $10 camping authorization. Added the Rogers Ford gate closure schedule (vehicle access closed late Sep - early Jan and mid-Apr - mid-May), which is what makes the --AWH 'seasonal-only' true. Note left as is.
flags: Waterfront + criteria lead: entry is riverfront at the Rogers Ford parking area, which on DWR's map is the Rogers Ford Boat Launch lot. DWR's statewide rule (https://dwr.virginia.gov/camping-on-wmas/): 'It is unlawful to camp within 300 feet of any lake or facility (building, boat ramp, etc.)'. Camping at the launch lot looks unlawful, and a legal spot 300 ft from the ramp is unlikely to be on the river.
